notes: Power Rankings, ranking components, remaining-schedule strength, and playoff odds were generated by Ironbound_power_ranks.
Weekly matchup lines and totals use projected-optimal legal lineups selected once before deterministic Monte Carlo simulation; submitted current starters are not used to set the line.
Weekly player usage is generated internally by Editorial Desk from nflverse data.
WAR and cWAR are optional analytical enrichment and are not required for weekly publication.
